大气的水平运动——风: Horizontal Motion of the Atmosphere: Wind
气压梯度力 → 偏向力 → 摩擦力 → 风: Pressure gradient force → Coriolis force → friction → wind
天气图上的风，为什么不是从高压直直吹向低压？: Why doesn't the wind on a weather map blow straight from high to low pressure?
等压线越密，气压梯度越大: The denser the isobars, the larger the pressure gradient
水平气压梯度力垂直等压线、指向低压: The horizontal pressure gradient force is perpendicular to the isobars and points toward low pressure
地转偏向力把风向拧向右（南半球向左）: The Coriolis force twists the wind to the right (to the left in the Southern Hemisphere)
高空两力抵消 → 平行；近地面加摩擦 → 斜交: Aloft the two forces cancel → parallel; near the surface friction is added → oblique
等压线越密，风越大: The denser the isobars, the stronger the wind

高处的盘：等压线自左 500 → 右 490 hPa，不受摩擦力: The upper disk: isobars from 500 on the left → 490 hPa on the right; no friction
图上一条条标着 1010、1008 的线，是什么？: What are the lines on the map labeled 1010, 1008 and so on?
拖一下视角：先看清下方那张近地面盘、上方那张高空盘，再看盘上那些竖着的等压线: Drag the view: first identify the surface disk below and the upper-air disk above, then look at the vertical isobars on each disk
下方盘从左到右标 1010 → 1000 hPa、上方盘标 500 → 490: The lower disk is labeled 1010 → 1000 hPa from left to right, the upper disk 500 → 490 hPa; in the reference case each disk has 6 lines 2 hPa apart; readings: pressure gradient 1.0 hPa/(100 km), wind 7.6 m/s
等压线是同一高度上气压相等的点的连线。单位距离间的气压差叫气压梯度：间距 200: Isobars are lines joining points of equal pressure at the same altitude. The pressure difference per unit distance is the pressure gradient: with 200 km spacing and 2 hPa between neighboring lines, the gradient is 1.0 hPa/(100 km).
facts A2.1、A2.2、A2.7、A3.1、B1 DP_ISO / N_: facts A2.1, A2.2, A2.7, A3.1, B1 DP_ISO / N_ISO, table 1
等压线是同一高度上气压相等的点的连线（教材原句）。: Isobars are lines joining points of equal pressure at the same altitude (textbook wording).
同一张盘上的等压线标的是同一层的气压：近地面盘左 1010 → 右 1000 h: The isobars on one disk give the pressure at one level: surface disk 1010 on the left → 1000 hPa on the right, upper-air disk 500 → 490 hPa, 2 hPa between neighbors (schematic).
单位距离间的气压差叫气压梯度；参考工况间距 200 km、相邻差 2 hPa，梯: The pressure difference per unit distance is the pressure gradient; in the reference case the spacing is 200 km and neighbors differ by 2 hPa, so the gradient is 1.0 hPa/(100 km).
去掉这一步：学生会把等压线当成 p.36 讲过的「等压面」，看到盘上的线就说不清: Skip this step and students confuse isobars with the "isobaric surfaces" of p.36 and can't say which level's pressure the lines show.
常考：等压线是同一高度上气压相等的点的连线，别和等压面混。: Often tested: isobars join points of equal pressure at the same altitude; don't mix them up with isobaric surfaces.
气压梯度 = 相邻两条的气压差 ÷ 间距: Pressure gradient = pressure difference between neighbors ÷ spacing
只有气压梯度力的时候，风往哪里吹？: With only the pressure gradient force, which way does the wind blow?
把「等压线间距」从 200 拖到 100 km：看等压线挤紧、红色梯度力箭头变长: Drag "Isobar spacing" from 200 to 100 km: watch the isobars crowd together and the red gradient-force arrow lengthen
间距 200→100 km：气压梯度 1.0→2.0 hPa/(100 km)，: Spacing 200→100 km: pressure gradient 1.0→2.0 hPa/(100 km), the red gradient-force arrow doubles in length; the pale cyan "hypothetical wind" stays on top of it, pointing right, crossing the isobars at right angles (textbook Fig. 2.14)
水平气压梯度力垂直于等压线、由高压指向低压。如果没有其他外力，风向就与它同向——: The horizontal pressure gradient force is perpendicular to the isobars and points from high to low pressure. Without other forces the wind would blow in the same direction; it is the direct cause of wind.
facts A2.1、A2.2、A2.7、A4-1、A4-2、表1/表3: facts A2.1, A2.2, A2.7, A4-1, A4-2, tables 1/3
水平气压梯度力的方向垂直于等压线，由高压指向低压（这盘上就是从左边高压指向右边低: The horizontal pressure gradient force is perpendicular to the isobars and points from high to low pressure (on this disk from high on the left to low on the right, "pointing right" on screen).
只要水平面上存在气压梯度，这个力就存在；它是形成风的直接原因。: Wherever there is a pressure gradient on a horizontal plane, this force exists; it is the direct cause of wind.
教材图 2.14 画的是「假设没有其他外力」的情形：风向与梯度力同向，两支箭头叠: Textbook Fig. 2.14 shows the case "assuming no other forces": the wind is in the same direction as the gradient force and the two arrows overlap.
去掉这一步：学生会把「由高压吹向低压」当成真实风向，而近地面风向其实是斜的。: Skip this step and students take "from high to low pressure" as the real wind direction, while near-surface wind is actually oblique.
常考：形成风的直接原因是水平气压梯度力；「垂直等压线、高压→低压」八个字要能画出: Often tested: the direct cause of wind is the horizontal pressure gradient force; you must be able to draw "perpendicular to isobars, high → low".
水平气压梯度力 ⊥ 等压线，由高压指向低压: Horizontal pressure gradient force ⊥ isobars, from high to low pressure
风一旦吹起来，为什么又被拧了一下？: Once the wind starts blowing, why does it get twisted?
点一下最下面那个位置的蓝色「偏向力」箭头：亮起直角标记: Click the blue "Coriolis force" arrow at the lowest position: a right-angle mark lights up
高空盘上是 6 个位置的一串箭头：红色梯度力每个位置都指右、一样长；蓝色偏向力总: The upper-air disk has a series of arrows at 6 positions: the red gradient force points right and is the same length everywhere; the blue Coriolis force is always perpendicular, on the right of the wind; the green wind turns right step by step from "pointing right (perpendicular to isobars)" to "pointing down (parallel to isobars)"; click the blue arrow at the last position and the right-angle mark lights up
地球自转让运动的空气不断向右（南半球向左）偏：风向从垂直等压线开始，被地转偏向力: Earth's rotation keeps deflecting moving air to the right (left in the Southern Hemisphere): the wind starts perpendicular to the isobars, is twisted bit by bit by the Coriolis force and ends parallel to them. The Coriolis force is always perpendicular to the wind and changes only its direction, not its speed.
facts A2.3、A2.4、A2.7（图 2.15 读图）、B1 SEQ_N: facts A2.3, A2.4, A2.7 (reading Fig. 2.15), B1 SEQ_N, B2.1-9, D2 / D5 / D11 / D12, table 2
风一旦形成，马上受到地转偏向力作用，风向逐渐偏离气压梯度力的方向（教材图 2.1: As soon as wind forms it is acted on by the Coriolis force, and its direction gradually departs from that of the pressure gradient force (Fig. 2.15 shows exactly this gradual process).
北半球风向向右偏转，南半球向左偏转。: In the Northern Hemisphere the wind is deflected to the right, in the Southern Hemisphere to the left.
地转偏向力始终垂直于风向（每个位置上的直角），只改变风向，不改变风速大小。: The Coriolis force is always perpendicular to the wind (the right angle at each position) and changes only the direction, not the speed.
去掉这一步：学生会以为风永远垂直等压线，图 2.15 / 2.16 里「风沿着等: Skip this step and students assume wind is always perpendicular to the isobars, so "wind along the isobars" in Figs. 2.15 / 2.16 makes no sense.
北半球右偏、南半球左偏；「只改变风向、不改变风速」几乎年年考。: Right in the north, left in the south; "changes only direction, not speed" is tested almost every year.
地转偏向力 ⊥ 风向，只改方向不改速度: Coriolis force ⊥ wind: changes direction, not speed
高空的风，为什么一直沿着等压线吹？: Why does upper-air wind keep blowing along the isobars?
把等压线拖密到 100 km：看两支力箭头一起变长，风向仍贴着等压线: Drag the isobars closer to 100 km: watch both force arrows lengthen while the wind stays along the isobars
间距 200→100 km：风速 8.9→17.8 m/s，风向与等压线的夹角始: Spacing 200→100 km: wind 8.9→17.8 m/s, angle to the isobars always 0.0°; the two force arrows are equal and opposite (8.3→16.7, ×10⁻⁴ m·s⁻²)
高空没有摩擦力：水平气压梯度力与地转偏向力大小相等、方向相反，风不再偏转，风向最: There is no friction aloft: the horizontal pressure gradient force and the Coriolis force are equal and opposite, the wind stops deflecting and ends up parallel to the isobars.
高空不受摩擦力，只剩水平气压梯度力与地转偏向力两个力。: Aloft there is no friction, only the horizontal pressure gradient force and the Coriolis force.
两力大小相等、方向相反（盘面上两支箭头等长反向），风就稳定下来不再偏。: The two forces are equal and opposite (two arrows of equal length pointing opposite ways on the disk), so the wind settles and stops deflecting.
结果：风向最终与等压线平行（教材图 2.15 最后那个位置）。: Result: the wind ends up parallel to the isobars (the last position in Fig. 2.15).
去掉这一步：学生会把「风平行等压线」当成要背的规则，而不是两个力抵消的结果。: Skip this step and students memorize "wind parallel to isobars" as a rule instead of the result of two forces cancelling.
高空风与等压线平行；等压线越密，高空风也越大。: Upper-air wind is parallel to the isobars; the denser the isobars, the stronger the upper-air wind too.
高空：梯度力 + 偏向力 = 0 → 风向 ∥ 等压线: Aloft: gradient force + Coriolis force = 0 → wind ∥ isobars
贴地这一层，风为什么又斜了？: In the layer next to the ground, why is the wind oblique again?

摩擦系数 0→0.6：风向与等压线的夹角 0.0°→31°，风速 8.9→7.6: Friction coefficient 0→0.6: angle between wind and isobars 0.0°→31°, wind 8.9→7.6 m/s; the red gradient force points right, the blue Coriolis force down-left, the purple friction up-left (opposite the wind), and the green wind crosses the isobars obliquely to the lower right (textbook Fig. 2.16); the three forces join head to tail in a closed triangle
近地面还要受摩擦力：摩擦力与风向相反、减小风速。三个力共同作用下，风向与等压线斜: Near the surface there is also friction, opposite the wind, reducing its speed. Under the three forces together the wind crosses the isobars obliquely, toward the low-pressure side.
facts A2.5、A2.7（图 2.16 读图）、A4-4、A4-5、D3、: facts A2.5, A2.7 (reading Fig. 2.16), A4-4, A4-5, D3, D8, tables 1/2
近地面还受摩擦力：地面和空气之间、运动状况不同的空气层之间相互作用产生的阻力。: Near the surface there is also friction: resistance from the interaction between the ground and the air, and between layers of air moving differently.
摩擦力与风向相反，对风有阻碍作用，可以减小风速。: Friction is opposite the wind, hinders it and reduces wind speed.
三力共同作用下风向与等压线斜交（教材图 2.16），但仍指向低压一侧：参考工况: Under the three forces the wind crosses the isobars obliquely (textbook Fig. 2.16), but still toward the low-pressure side: 31° in the reference case.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「高空平行、近地面斜交」，说不出差别的原因就是摩擦力。: Skip this step and students recite "parallel aloft, oblique near the surface" without knowing that friction is the reason for the difference.
近地面风向与等压线斜交、仍指向低压；摩擦使风速减小。: Near-surface wind crosses the isobars obliquely, still toward low pressure; friction reduces wind speed.
梯度力 + 偏向力 + 摩擦力 = 0 → 风向斜穿等压线: Gradient force + Coriolis force + friction = 0 → wind crosses isobars obliquely

整串箭头镜像：北半球风从「指右」逐个右偏到「向下」，南半球从「指右」逐个左偏到「: The whole series of arrows mirrors: in the north the wind turns right step by step from "pointing right" to "pointing down", in the south it turns left from "pointing right" to "pointing up"; the Coriolis force moves to the left of the wind; wind speed and angle stay the same
同一气压场上，北半球的风向右偏、南半球向左偏：风向镜像到另一侧，风速与等压线夹角: In the same pressure field, wind deflects right in the Northern Hemisphere and left in the Southern: the direction mirrors to the other side while wind speed and angle to the isobars stay the same.
facts A2.3、A2.7（图 2.16 旁思考题）、D6、D12、表2/表: facts A2.3, A2.7 (question beside Fig. 2.16), D6, D12, tables 2/5
同一气压场上，北半球风向偏右、南半球风向偏左。: In the same pressure field, wind deflects right in the Northern Hemisphere and left in the Southern.
画面里整串箭头镜像过去：北半球最后一支指向屏幕下方（南），南半球指向屏幕上方（北: The whole series of arrows mirrors on screen: in the north the last arrow points to the bottom of the screen (south), in the south to the top (north); wind speed and angle are unchanged.
判读口诀：背风而立，北半球低压在左、高压在右，南半球相反。: Rule of thumb: stand with your back to the wind; in the Northern Hemisphere low pressure is on your left and high on your right, the reverse in the south.
去掉这一步：学生会把「右偏」当成物理定律，画南半球天气图时方向全反。: Skip this step and students treat "deflects right" as a law of physics and get every direction wrong on Southern Hemisphere weather maps.
南半球左偏；同一张等压线上两半球的风向结论相反。: Left in the Southern Hemisphere; on the same isobars the two hemispheres give opposite wind directions.
北半球右偏 · 南半球左偏: Right in the north · left in the south
同一工况，只换半球（示意）: Same condition, only the hemisphere changes (schematic)
等压线挤在一起的地方，风为什么更大？: Why is the wind stronger where the isobars are crowded together?
把间距从 300 拖到 100 km：看等压线挤紧、四支箭头一起变长: Drag the spacing from 300 to 100 km: watch the isobars crowd together and all four arrows lengthen

等压线越密，气压梯度越大，风力越大；判风向仍按「北半球右偏、斜穿等压线指向低压」: The denser the isobars, the larger the pressure gradient and the stronger the wind; wind direction is still judged by "deflects right in the north, crosses isobars obliquely toward low pressure".
facts A2.6、A2.7（图 2.17 图面）、D4、D7、表1/表3/表: facts A2.6, A2.7 (Fig. 2.17), D4, D7, tables 1/3/4
等压线的疏密程度反映了气压梯度的大小，等压线越密，气压梯度越大（教材 p.40: The spacing of isobars reflects the size of the pressure gradient; the denser the isobars, the larger the gradient (textbook p.40 wording).
间距 300→100 km：梯度 0.7→2.0 hPa/(100 km)、风速: Spacing 300→100 km: gradient 0.7→2.0 hPa/(100 km), wind 5.1→15.2 m/s.
教材 p.40 活动里甲（蒙古东部，等压线密）与乙（四川盆地南缘，等压线稀）就是: The textbook p.40 activity compares Jia (eastern Mongolia, dense isobars) and Yi (southern edge of the Sichuan Basin, sparse isobars) in exactly this way.
去掉这一步：学生会只看气压数值大小，把「1000 hPa 的地方风大」当成结论。: Skip this step and students only look at the pressure values and conclude "wind is strong where it's 1000 hPa".
等压线越密风越大；判风力要同时说气压梯度与摩擦力两个依据。: Denser isobars, stronger wind; to judge wind strength give both reasons: pressure gradient and friction.
等压线越密 → 梯度越大 → 风越大: Denser isobars → larger gradient → stronger wind
相邻差 2 hPa 不变，只改间距（示意）: Neighbors still 2 hPa apart, only spacing changes (schematic)
考核：让风速 ≥ 12 m/s，风向贴近等压线: Assessment: get wind ≥ 12 m/s blowing close to the isobars

目标条变绿：风速 ≥ 12.0 m/s、夹角 ≤ 15°。等压线要密（间距 14: The goal bar turns green: wind ≥ 12.0 m/s, angle ≤ 15°. The isobars must be dense (140 km spacing) and the ground smooth (friction coefficient 0.25)
风的大小与方向由气压梯度和摩擦力共同决定：等压线越密、地面越光滑，风越大、越接近: Wind strength and direction are set jointly by the pressure gradient and friction: the denser the isobars and smoother the ground, the stronger the wind and the closer it is to parallel with the isobars.
facts B1 V_EXAM / A_EXAM、D10、表8: facts B1 V_EXAM / A_EXAM, D10, table 8
先把「等压线间距」拖小：气压梯度变大，风就变大。: First drag "Isobar spacing" down: the pressure gradient grows and the wind strengthens.
再把「摩擦系数」拖小：摩擦力减小，风向更贴近等压线。: Then drag "Friction coefficient" down: friction decreases and the wind lies closer to the isobars.

去掉这一步：学生只会复述结论，面对一张天气图还是判不出风大风小。: Skip this step and students can only repeat conclusions and still can't judge strong or weak wind from a weather map.
综合：气压梯度定风的大小，摩擦力定风与等压线的夹角。: Synthesis: the pressure gradient sets the wind strength, friction sets the angle between wind and isobars.

同一高度上气压相等的点的连线: A line joining points of equal pressure at the same altitude
同一气压下各点高度的连线: A line joining the heights of points at the same pressure
教材原句：等压线是同一高度上气压相等的点的连线（与「等压面」不同）。: Textbook: isobars are lines joining points of equal pressure at the same altitude (different from "isobaric surfaces").
形成风的直接原因是: The direct cause of wind is
只要水平面上存在气压梯度，就产生水平气压梯度力，大气由高压区流向低压区，形成风。: Wherever there is a pressure gradient on a horizontal plane there is a horizontal pressure gradient force, and air flows from high to low pressure, forming wind.
水平气压梯度力的方向是: The direction of the horizontal pressure gradient force is
平行等压线、由低压指向高压: Parallel to isobars, from low to high pressure
垂直等压线、由高压指向低压: Perpendicular to isobars, from high to low pressure
垂直等压线、由低压指向高压: Perpendicular to isobars, from low to high pressure
教材原句：水平气压梯度力的方向垂直于等压线，由高压指向低压。: Textbook: the horizontal pressure gradient force is perpendicular to the isobars and points from high to low pressure.
地转偏向力对风的作用是: The effect of the Coriolis force on wind is to
只改变风向，不改变风速: Change only its direction, not its speed
只改变风速，不改变风向: Change only its speed, not its direction
地转偏向力始终垂直于风向，所以只改变风向，不改变风速大小。: The Coriolis force is always perpendicular to the wind, so it changes only the direction, not the speed.
不受摩擦力时，风向最终: Without friction, the wind ends up
高空没有摩擦力，梯度力与偏向力大小相等、方向相反，风向与等压线平行。: There is no friction aloft; the gradient force and the Coriolis force are equal and opposite, so the wind is parallel to the isobars.
近地面的风向与等压线: Near-surface wind relative to the isobars is
近地面加摩擦力，风向与等压线斜交（参考工况 31°），水平气压梯度力仍指向低压，: Near the surface friction is added and the wind crosses the isobars obliquely (31° in the reference case); the horizontal pressure gradient force still points to low pressure, so the wind leans toward the low-pressure side.
同一幅图上，等压线越密的地方: On the same map, where the isobars are denser
气压梯度越小、风越小: The pressure gradient is smaller and the wind weaker
气压梯度越大、风越大: The pressure gradient is larger and the wind stronger
风速与疏密无关: Wind speed doesn't depend on spacing
只能判断风向、不能判断风速: You can judge only direction, not speed
教材 p.40：等压线的疏密程度反映了气压梯度的大小，等压线越密，气压梯度越大，: Textbook p.40: the spacing of isobars reflects the size of the pressure gradient; the denser the isobars, the larger the gradient and the stronger the wind.
南半球的风向相对气压梯度力: In the Southern Hemisphere, relative to the pressure gradient force, the wind
北半球右偏、南半球左偏，这是地转偏向力方向随半球改变的结果。: Right in the north, left in the south: the direction of the Coriolis force changes with the hemisphere.
看懂风往哪吹、为什么有的地方风大。: Understand which way wind blows and why it is stronger in some places.
